messages:
Zoe Li: Quick heads-up — planning to enable a header-based SDK gate for the new routing optimizations. Goal: roll to 10% canary by client version, with a min-version check and soft-fail fallback. pinging eng-platform + mobile teams for consent.
Marco R.: Can you paste the exact header shape you want? also which SDKs are in scope (web, ios, android)?
Zoe Li: header: `x-rw-feature:new-routing=1;v=2` — plan is to require `v>=2.4.0` for full enable, otherwise SDK should ignore header and continue current behavior. scope: web + mobile (iOS/Android) for the first canary.
Priya S.: For mobile: how do you want to handle older installs that never update? We should avoid hard failures. Soft fallback ok?
Zoe Li: yes soft fallback only. If SDK sees header but version < min, it should log a telemetry event and proceed without the feature. We'll add a server-side guard to not send the header unless the user is in canary & token allows.
Daniel K.: Suggest adding an opt-out flag on server if we see error spikes: `x-rw-feature-disable:new-routing=1`. We can flip quickly from infra side.
Marco R.: one more — how do we define canary audience? percent-based or user lists?
Zoe Li: hybrid: 10% random by user-id for web, and for mobile we'll seed with specific beta tokens we already issue (token allowlist). We'll keep the percent gate for mobile after first week.
Priya S.: Mobile note: the iOS SDK has a header size limit on older networking layer; keep header minimal. Also we need a small client patch to parse semicolon format. I can push PR tomorrow.
mobile-ci-bot: build #482 passed for ios-sdk@2.4.1-rc — artifact available at https://ci.internal/rw/ios/482 :white_check_mark:
Zoe Li: PR reviewers: @Marco R. for server, @Priya S. for mobile parsing, @Daniel K. for telemetry schema. I'll open the rollout RFC in the repo with rollout steps and SLOs.
Marco R.: ack. For server side, I'll add the percent gate and the disable header override. Will add a rollout toggle `rollout.new_routing=<percent>` in config.
Priya S.: i'll add client logic: 1) parse header, 2) check semver >= 2.4.0, 3) if ok enable, else emit `client.header_ignored` event with reason `min_version`. Quick snippet I'll include in PR: 
```
const header = getHeader('x-rw-feature');
const parsed = parseFeatureHeader(header); // {name, enabled, v}
if (parsed.name === 'new-routing' && parsed.enabled) {
  if (semver.gte(sdkVersion, parsed.v)) enableRouting();
  else telemetry.emit('client.header_ignored', {reason: 'min_version', clientVersion: sdkVersion});
}
```
Daniel K.: Add a telemetry flag for fallback counts + latency delta so we can watch quality regressions. Set alert if fallback rate > 5% of requests in canary.
Zoe Li: agreed. Can we get initial canary start tomorrow 9:00 PST? I'll coordinate the rollout PR and server config change. Please post any objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
Marco R.: no objections from infra side.
Priya S.: no objections from mobile. PR incoming.
Daniel K.: i'll wire telemetry dashboards and an alert.
Zoe Li: thanks all — i'll create a short checklist in the RFC: canary audience, header schema, min-version, server guard, disable override, telemetry alerts, rollback steps.
mobile-ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary config updated: rollout.new_routing=10% — scheduled 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z
Zoe Li: noted. launching on schedule unless we hear issues. :rocket:
